prompt:
Please review my code changes against the ticket requirements below.

Ticket: PIQ-512 - Add JWT authentication to payment-iq API

Description:
The payment-iq service currently has no authentication. We need to add JWT-based auth to protect all endpoints.

Requirements:
1. All API endpoints must require a valid JWT token in the Authorization header
2. JWT tokens should be validated against our shared secret (from env var JWT_SECRET)
3. Requests with missing or invalid tokens must return 401 Unauthorized
4. The decoded JWT payload should be available to request handlers
5. A whitelist of public endpoints (e.g. /health) should bypass authentication
6. Token expiry must be enforced

assertions.text: Report verdict is NON-COMPLIANT (the branch has no JWT auth implementation)
